# Theory: Reconciliation is Compare Desired to Actual, Forever

Argo CD’s Application is a pointer at Git (desired) plus a cluster (actual). The controller loop diffs and optionally syncs. Immutable infrastructure: replace, do not SSH-mutate.

## Invariants

1. Five-step loop: detect, compare, present, sync (if policy), record.
2. Repo server renders manifests (Helm/Kustomize/plain) in a sandbox.
3. Sync status and health are different questions.

```text
Git  →  repo-server  →  desired manifests
cluster API  →  actual
controller: diff + sync policy
```

## What can break

- Editing live resources that auto-sync will revert.

## How to read this chapter

History, reconciliation, loop, components, apps/projects, path to cluster, desired vs actual.
